description: One transaction read and explained in plain words: who moved what to whom, through which programs, the swap or bridge transfer it made, its parties with their labels, and (Solana) the acts that need a key and tie two wallets: control of a token account handed over, an account closed into another wallet, a fee paid for another signer, wallets signing together, a spending approval, a wallet assigned to a program. A Solana signature, an EVM hash, or a dYdX, Noble, Bitcoin or Tron hash. Free with an Iris account (limited per minute, and per day without a paid plan).

chain.description: Optional: the chain. Read from the hash otherwise (an EVM hash is looked for on every EVM chain).

hash.description: The transaction: a Solana signature (base58), an EVM hash (0x...), or a dYdX, Noble, Bitcoin or Tron hash.

name: explain_transaction
title: Explain one transaction
